Supreme Court Upholds MLA Danam Nagender's Disqualification

The Supreme Court has upheld a decision by the Telangana High Court to disqualify former MLA Danam Nagender. The disqualification was based on a defection case. Kaushik Reddy hailed the Supreme Court's verdict.
